pages.title: Eight guardians
text: Every March biome keeps a **guardian**: the thing each tribe's story ends at (see [Elders, requests and stories](elders_and_stories)). They are bosses in every sense: a boss bar, no knockback, no potions, no Soul Urn, two phases, and a fight worth preparing for.

A guardian never wanders in. Each has a **ground** in its biome, a ring of stone with a **Guardian Altar** at its centre, and it rises only from that altar: the altar must sit on polished deepslate with a lit candle at each corner (altar or nothing), there must be room above it, and it rests about twenty minutes between calls.
Use the altar with an empty hand and it tells you what it wants: a fistful of that biome's reagent, eight by default. Lay it on and stand back.

pages.title: Two phases
text: At half health every guardian is **roused**: its signature attack, every **4 seconds** before, comes about every **2.4 seconds** and hits harder, and it calls its biome's creatures to its side, **2** at once and **2** more every **15 seconds**, never more than **6**. Those creatures drop nothing and vanish when it falls.
If no one stays within **48 blocks** for half a minute, the guardian goes back to sleep unbeaten; the altar does not need its rest after that, and can be called again at once.
A called creature you bond in the fight is yours: a Storm Moth from the Roost, say, once the Pattern-weavers call you **Voice**. It stops counting for the guardian and stays when the fight ends.

When it falls, everyone within **48 blocks** who is on that tribe's story finishes the **trial**, and its **core** drops with a heap of reagents and **2 to 3 Resonant Cores**. Each ground also keeps a chest that can hold Resonant Cores, Loom Thread, a golden apple or a blank Lore Tablet.

pages.title: Slag Titan
text: A walking smelter: a furnace-bellied giant with crucible fists and a chimney crown. **The Slag Throne in the Ember Wastes**. Called with Magma Scales. **360 health** and **12 armour**. Sneak to brace against its slams; in its second phase the rings ignite and Cinder Imps rise from the slag. Its fall closes the **Drumhearts'** story.
Drops the **Slag Core**, **8 to 14 Magma Scales**, **4 to 8 Cinder Bark** and **2 to 3 Resonant Cores**.

pages.title: Bog Matriarch
text: A great brood toad carrying her young on her back, hung with reeds and root barbels. **The Drowned Root in the Reed Fen**. Called with Reed Fangs. **320 health** and **8 armour**. Its snare drags you in and slows you, and poisons you once it is roused; keep to solid ground, and cut down the Reed Stalkers it calls before they swarm. Its fall closes the **Rootbinders'** story.
Drops the **Fen Heart**, **8 to 14 Reed Fangs**, **4 to 8 Knotted Roots** and **2 to 3 Resonant Cores**.

pages.title: Cairn Wight
text: A stack of lit cairn stones under an elk skull, in a mantle of rime. **The Cairn Ring in the Snow Fields**. Called with Rime Mandibles. **300 health** and **6 armour**. Its breath freezes everything in front of it. Circle behind, and deal with the Rime Crawlers it calls. Its fall closes the **Colony-keepers'** story.
Drops the **Cairn Stone**, **8 to 14 Rime Mandibles**, **4 to 8 Pale Down** and **2 to 3 Resonant Cores**.

pages.title: Prism Serpent
text: A crystal wyrm with a prism spine and a gem crest. **The Singing Fracture in the Crystal Fields**. Called with Prism Carapace. **300 health** and **8 armour**. It fires bolts of light that mark you glowing. Strafe, close in, and watch the second bolt it adds in phase two, when Shard Stalkers join it. Its fall closes the **Grit-singers'** story.
Drops the **Prism Core**, **8 to 14 Prism Carapaces**, **4 to 8 Glimmer Dust** and **2 to 3 Resonant Cores**.

pages.title: Vault Sentinel
text: A walking vault door: a construct whose chest is a sealed vault, with slabs for blades. **The Sealed Gate on Glimmer Ridge**. Called with Sentinel Sigils. **380 health** and **16 armour**, the heaviest in the March, and a sweep that throws you off the ridge. In phase two it wards itself for three seconds at a time (wait it out) and calls Gloom Crawlers. Its fall closes the **Seal-carvers'** story.
Drops the **Vault Seal**, **8 to 14 Sentinel Sigils**, **4 to 8 Gloom Silk** and **2 to 3 Resonant Cores**.

pages.title: Tide Drummer
text: A giant hermit crab living in a barnacled war drum, beating it with its claws. **The Tide Stone in the Shallows**. Called with Brine Fangs. **320 health** and **8 armour**. Each beat pulls everyone toward it and hurts; roused, it slows you too and calls Brine Lurkers. Fight it from the shore with your back to something solid. Its fall closes the **Pattern-weavers'** story.
Drops the **Tide Shell**, **8 to 14 Brine Fangs**, **4 to 8 Shoal Scales** and **2 to 3 Resonant Cores**.

pages.title: Stampede Spirit
text: A spirit aurochs with a bone mask, lyre horns and a mane of dust. **The Trampled Ring on the Steppe**. Called with Shank Sinew. **300 health** and **6 armour**. It charges. Sidestep and hit it as it passes, and cut the Burrow Gnashers down before its next charge. Its fall closes the **Pad-keepers'** story.
Drops the **Herd Horn**, **8 to 14 Shank Sinew**, **4 to 8 Boulder Tusks** and **2 to 3 Resonant Cores**.

pages.title: Storm Roc
text: A thunderbird: a crested storm eagle with bars of lightning in its wings. **The Roost on the Highlands**. Called with Storm Wings. **280 health** and **4 armour**. It swoops and throws you into the air, and in phase two lightning follows each swoop and Storm Moths join it. A bow and a roof help more than a shield. Its fall closes the **Edge-walkers'** story.
Drops the **Storm Plume**, **8 to 14 Storm Wings**, **4 to 8 Pale Down** and **2 to 3 Resonant Cores**.

pages.title: What the cores are for
text: Each core with a Loom Thread makes six Resonant Cores, the fastest way to them in the game. All eight cores together with an {item:tribalpower:unsung_heart} make the tablet of [The Ninth Agreement](ninth_agreement).
